Axiom: Hooks fire on every commit/push. `pre-commit` is one full mechanical pass, run as ONE hook command: the format + lint script `AX_PRETTIER_OWNS_FORMATTING` owns (staged files), chained with a whole-project typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) in the same command. Budget is honest, not aspirational: tens of seconds, not sub-5s — `tsc --noEmit` is whole-project by construction, not scoped to staged files, and no amount of staged-file filtering makes a real type check fit a five-second budget. `pre-push` runs the full test suite; tests do not belong in `pre-commit` — a suite run on every commit is the friction that pushes operators toward `--no-verify`. `commit-msg` (conventional-commits validator) stays required. Optional: `prepare-commit-msg` (prepend issue ID), `post-merge` (reinstall if lock changed). Hook config committed to repo; one onboarding command registers them (e.g. `lefthook install`).
